text: Program Description 1. Teaching Object Editor Notes: This program is designed to cultivate high-qualified professional electronic engineers. To have the abilities of solid theoretical knowledge and sufficient engineering. Be fit in the requirements of modernization construction. Be able to do research and development and management related with electronics and information systems. To cultivate high engineering and technology talents. To enhance students' characteristics of morality, intelligence and physique. Be engaged in airplane maintenance technology and management in civil aviation company. 2. Program Introduction Editor Notes: The study duration of this program is 4 years. This program will cultivate students with a knowledge of natural science, good humanities, art and social science base. Students should have a systematic wide theory knowledge include electric and automation science, airplane electric system maintenance, mechanic and electron, computer and business management. This program will train students with airplane maintenance technology development direction. Students should have good creative idea and high comprehensive quality. 3. Program Structure Editor Notes: This program includes 12 main courses. Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis Signals Systems Analog Electronic Circuits Pulse and Digital Circuits Engineering Electromagnetic Fields and Waves Digital Signal Processing High Frequency Electronic Circuits The Principle of Communication Principle and Application of Microcomputer The Principle of Automatic Control Microwave Techniques Antennas 4 . Internship and Career Editor Notes: Students have lots of internship opportunities and have good future careers. Students who have been in valid F-1 status for at least two consecutive semesters and who plan to seek employment in the U.S can have Optional Practical Training. On-campus works are limited per semester in the areas of facilities management, administration, and instructional assistance. The School offers off-campus internship opportunities to related enterprise. The School is to train the outstanding talents with international perspective and competitiveness. There are 5 international joint research institutions, 30 international students and above 20 joint graduate students. ​5. School Introduction Editor Notes: NPU is one of the 211 and 985 universities and enjoys a high reputation. Northwestern Polytechnical University (NPU) is located in ancient capital city of Xi'an. NPU is China's only research-oriented, multi-disciplinary, and international university of science and technology, which simultaneously excels at aeronautics, astronautics, and marine technology. The university emphasizes science and technology, while harmoniously developing the fields of management, humanities, economics, and law. The university is affiliated with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology , Learn More>> 6. Department of Electronic and Information Engineering Editor Notes: It focuses on the area of electronic engineering and information systems. The School has made great dedication to the areas of national defense, economic construction and social progress of the country. The School has done lots of national projects, such as The National Natural Science Foundation of China, the 863 project, defense scientific projects and international joint projects. There are above 20 famous experts from overseas.
